name: Kibo UI

install.verified: npx kibo-ui add gantt (live docs); https://www.kibo-ui.com/r/gantt.json and /r/announcement.json verified to return shadcn-registry-item JSON with files[].content

notes: Free and open source, forever (repo description); MIT license, copyright shadcnblocks. No paid or gated components; the only "pricing" on the site is a free demo block.
Repo renamed/moved: haydenbleasel/kibo now redirects to github.com/shadcnblocks/kibo (GitHub API resolves both to shadcnblocks/kibo).

Registry index at https://www.kibo-ui.com/r/registry.json contains 41 items (40 registry:ui + 1 registry:style for typography). Per-item endpoint /r/<slug>.json serves shadcn registry-item schema JSON with files[].content.
Docs URL pattern is https://www.kibo-ui.com/components/<slug> (NOT /docs/components/<slug>). Categories are the library's own docs-nav headings (fumadocs meta.json), captured verbatim.

Primary documented install is the dedicated CLI "npx kibo-ui add <slug>" (npm package kibo-ui, v1.1.5). The shadcn-CLI URL form works via the verified /r/<slug>.json endpoint. Main-branch docs also show "npx shadcn add @kibo-ui/<slug>" via a registry namespace, but that variant was not yet rendered on the live site.
Requires shadcn/ui initialized in the project (CSS-variables theming mode only); components are copied into the codebase (default @/components/kibo-ui/), not installed from npm.

Separate "Blocks" docs section (https://www.kibo-ui.com/blocks) documents 28 page-level blocks: Applications (codebase, collaborative-canvas, roadmap) and Websites (about, awards, blog, blogpost, careers, case-studies, case-study, changelog, code-example, community, compare, compliance, contact, cta, download, experience, faq, feature, footer, form, hero, pricing, stats, team, testimonial). Blocks install ONLY via "npx kibo-ui add <block>" (e.g. hero); they are absent from registry.json and have no /r/<slug>.json endpoint.
Docs nav also lists two third-party "Recommended" libraries (AI Elements, React Wheel Picker) - external links, not part of this registry.

No external-service accounts required by any component: sandbox bundles code in-browser via CodeSandbox Sandpack (@codesandbox/sandpack-react, no account); glimpse fetches target URLs server-side and parses meta tags itself; cursor is realtime-ready but ships no transport (bring your own). No Supabase/Liveblocks dependencies anywhere in the registry.
typography registry item is type registry:style and ships CSS (no files[].content in index; installed via its registry entry).
